Since the two plants <f100r>[3,1] and <f100r>[3,2] seem to have their own labels, <f100r.L3.1> and <f100r.L3.2b>, we have assumed that the word above and between them is associated with the container. Between plants <f100r>[3,1] and <f100r>[3,2], at top. Kluge's 27A.

plant <f100r>[2,1] - leaves with eyes plant <f100r>[2,2] - leaves on left side of stem only East of plant <f100r>[2,2], below leaves. Kluge's 21A.

plant <f100r>[2,3] - leaf(?) with white teeth East of plant <f100r>[2,3], near root tip. Kluge's 22A in <f100r>.
